debates.question: 幸福到底是什么？我们是否应该追求幸福？
debates.question_en: What is happiness, really? And should we even pursue it?

debates.question: AI 时代，人如何夺回注意力与存在的意义？
debates.question_en: In the age of AI, how do we reclaim our attention and the meaning of our existence?

debates.question: AI 取代了人类工作后，人类是否会迎来「存在危机」？普通人怎样面对大面积中年失业的情况？
debates.question_en: After AI replaces human work, will humanity face an 'existential crisis'? And how should ordinary people cope with mass midlife unemployment?

debates.question: 原生家庭的创伤：我们多大程度被童年塑造？能否真正走出来？是否有希望改变父母？
debates.question_en: Trauma from the family we're born into: how much does childhood shape us, can we truly move past it, and is there any hope of changing our parents?

debates.question: AI 与算法：在增强我们，还是在让我们退化？
debates.question_en: AI and algorithms: are they augmenting us, or making us atrophy?

debates.question: AI 时代该怎么养孩子？——拼命鸡娃、挤名校到底还值不值得？
debates.question_en: Raising kids in the age of AI: is intense 'tiger parenting' and chasing elite schools still worth it?

debates.question: 科技大厂的『扁平化』——一个经理带 30–50 人，会成为常态吗？
debates.question_en: Big-tech 'flattening' — one manager over 30–50 reports: is this the new normal?

debates.question: 是否有“造物主”，如果有的话，TA为什么要造出人类？
debates.question_en: Is there a 'Creator'? And if so, why would they have made humankind?

debates.question: 一个好的『管理者』，到底是怎样的？
debates.question_en: What actually makes a good manager?

debates.question: “知道”和“做到”之间的差异是如何产生的？（知道该锻炼、早睡，却很难做到）
debates.question_en: Why is there a gap between knowing and doing? (We know we should exercise and sleep early — yet rarely do.)

debates.question: 人是否应该追求长生，如果人真的能够长生，世界会怎样？
debates.question_en: Should we pursue immortality — and if humans really could live forever, what would the world become?

debates.question: 我们该如何面对死亡？如何做到「向死而生」？
debates.question_en: How should we face death — and how do we actually live 'toward' it (being-toward-death)?

debates.question: 金钱能（在多大程度上）买到幸福？
debates.question_en: Can money buy happiness — and how much?

debates.question: 「只专注于你能控制的」是处世智慧，还是一种对改不了的不公视而不见的特权式逃避？
debates.question_en: Is 'focus only on what you can control' practical wisdom, or a privileged way of looking past injustice you could help change?

debates.question: 现在的年轻人（尤其在亚洲）为什么不想生孩子？这对个人与社会意味着什么？
debates.question_en: Why don't young people — especially in Asia — want children anymore, and what does it mean for the individual and for society?

debates.question: 为什么这一代人越来越难谈恋爱、走入亲密关系？是个人问题，还是时代造的？
debates.question_en: Why is this generation finding it ever harder to date and form intimate relationships — a personal failing, or one the age has made?

debates.question: 儒、释、道的异同：三家分歧究竟在哪，又在何处殊途同归？
debates.question_en: Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism: where do the three traditions truly differ, and where do they converge?

debates.question: 普通人投资，该买大盘指数，还是买自己拿着放心的个股？
debates.question_en: For ordinary investors: buy the broad index, or the individual stocks you can hold with confidence?

debates.question: 靠恐惧驱动的优秀（『要够好才配被爱』）该不该放下？放下了，会不会就失去前进的动力？
debates.question_en: Excellence driven by fear ('I must be good enough to deserve love') — should we let it go, and if we do, do we lose the drive to move forward?
